title: Error state does not clear on successful retry in PIN gate
reasoning: The check function sets setError(true) on failure but only sets setError(false) on success. The handleDigit function sets setError(false) immediately when the user types. However, if the user completes 4 digits and check() runs asynchronously via setTimeout (line 1359), there is a 80ms window where the error flag may briefly flash. More critically, the manualCheck button (line 1379) calls check() synchronously without clearing error first. If a user enters a wrong PIN via the button, then types a correct PIN, the error state clears in handleDigit, but the red border animation from PinGate.tsx line 1161 may briefly persist due to React render timing.
reproduction:
1. Enter wrong PIN via button → error state set
2. Type correct PIN → error cleared by handleDigit, but animation timing may show stale error
recommendation: In check(), call setError(false) at the start to ensure it clears before success/failure logic. Alternatively, ensure manualCheck clears error before calling check().
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests are included. This timing issue requires UI testing with async state updates.
suggestedRegressionTest: Enter wrong PIN, then correct PIN via typing, and assert error is false after completion.
minimumFixScope: src/src/portal/hooks.ts check function: add setError(false) at start
